definitions.pi: pi(dimension, method, compound) = #distinct bootstrap repeats in which the compound is in that method's Top-3 for that dimension / #distinct bootstrap repeats present in the artifact
definitions.edge_fraction: share of CELLS lying on a declared edge (floor code / observed support min-max / 0) of the standardised design matrix; a data-domain boundary share, NOT a constraint-adjacency share
definitions.constraint_residual: transfer_constraints.csv `residual` = clamp(new - source, 0) in stored space for upper bounds, clamp(-new, 0) for lower_zero rows; this is a BOUND residual
definitions.new_minus_source: transfers.csv stored_new - stored_source (and the calibrated physical equivalent); this is the DESIGN MOVEMENT, not a constraint violation
definitions.empirical_V_vs_U: V = 2*mean d(G,R) - sum d(G,G)/m^2 - sum d(R,R)/n^2 (unsigned); U = 2*mean d(G,R) - mean d(G,G) - mean d(R,R) is SIGNED, can be negative, never clipped
definitions.rerun_semantics: fixed-seed independent-rerun is a DETERMINISTIC REPRODUCTION (same code/data/seed); it is not an independent implementation and not external validation
definitions.native_optimization: the 198-QP batch has NO native optimization-feasibility/optimization-objective VAL; the certificate audit (SCRIPT-0010) and the z-space reconstruction (SCRIPT-0011) are audits, not native checks

Q1.rerunSemantics: deterministic reproduction only (VAL-0065 / EXP-0083), not an independent implementation

Q2.pi_definition: distinct bootstrap repeats containing the candidate / distinct repeats present
Q2.metric_nature: topk-jaccard is between-method SET AGREEMENT, not predictive accuracy

Q3gen.energy_U_note: signed diagnostic; negative values are preserved, never clipped or square-rooted
Q3gen.edge_fraction_note: share of CELLS on a declared edge (floor code / observed support min-max / 0); NOT a constraint-adjacency share
Q3gen.constraint_satisfaction_nature: CONSTRUCTION property of the constrained projection, not an empirical discovery and not a distribution-quality or brewing-validity proof

definitionsFromArtifact.energyDistanceV: V = 2*mean d(G,R) - sum d(G,G)/m^2 - sum d(R,R)/n^2 on the fold-standardised storage matrix; E_V_norm = V / D_train with D_train the mean pairwise distance of the style's TRAIN rows
definitionsFromArtifact.energyDistanceU: U = 2*mean d(G,R) - mean d(G,G) - mean d(R,R): a SIGNED diagnostic, can be negative, never clipped and never square-rooted
definitionsFromArtifact.duplicateShare: fraction of rows that are exact duplicates of an earlier row of the same block
definitionsFromArtifact.edgeFraction: fraction of cells on a declared edge (floor code / observed support min or max / 0)

Q3gen.constraint_residual_note: bound residual = clamp(new-source,0); NOT a new-source movement
Q3gen.native_optimization_val: none (generation has no declared optimization model)

Q3transfer.trivial_control: source-fixed applies NO transfer (new == source); it is a trivial control, never evidence of transfer quality
Q3transfer.nonincrease_note: nonincrease-rate = 1.000 for the constrained strategies is a CONSTRUCTION outcome of the hard bound and the metric is saturated/bounded; min 1 >= 1 is not an improvement measure

new_minus_source.definition: stored_new - stored_source (stored space) and physical_new - physical_source (calibrated)
